title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must correctly represent the time read by the earth clock when the spaceship clock reads one hour.

title: Transformation Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Lorentz transformation equations for time and space.

title: Use of Gamma
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define and use the Lorentz factor gamma in their calculations.

title: Light Signal Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the time taken for the light signal to reach the earthman.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the transformation equations.

title: Beta Definition
description: Optional Criteria: The student should define beta correctly as the ratio of velocity to the speed of light.
